faqs.q: How does SecuEdge help with PCI DSS compliance?
faqs.a: SecuEdge provides comprehensive controls specifically aligned with PCI DSS requirements. Our solution includes end-to-end encryption for cardholder data, network segmentation, access controls, continuous monitoring, and detailed audit logging. We provide documentation that maps our security controls directly to PCI DSS requirements, simplifying the compliance process and reducing the scope of your PCI audit.

faqs.q: How does SecuEdge protect our POS systems?
faqs.a: Our POS protection includes specialized defenses against retail-specific malware like RAM scrapers and keyloggers. We use application control to prevent unauthorized software, memory protection to detect when applications attempt to access payment card data, file integrity monitoring to identify unauthorized changes, and network controls to prevent POS systems from communicating with unauthorized destinations. All of this is designed to work without disrupting checkout operations.

faqs.q: How does SecuEdge protect against e-commerce attacks?
faqs.a: Our e-commerce protection includes specialized defenses against formjacking and digital skimming. We continuously monitor your website's client-side code for unauthorized changes, block connections to known malicious domains, detect suspicious script behavior, and protect payment forms from unauthorized access. We also provide a web application firewall tailored to e-commerce platforms with rules designed to block common attack patterns targeting online retailers.

faqs.q: Will implementing SecuEdge disrupt our retail operations?
faqs.a: No, we design our implementation specifically to avoid any disruption to retail operations. We use a phased approach that starts with monitoring mode to understand your environment, followed by gradual policy implementation with extensive testing. We schedule implementation activities during off-peak hours and can pause deployments during high-volume retail periods like holidays. Our retail security experts work closely with your team to ensure security measures integrate seamlessly with customer-facing systems.

faqs.q: How does SecuEdge address omnichannel security?
faqs.a: SecuEdge provides unified visibility and protection across all retail channels. Our solution correlates security events between in-store, online, mobile, and other channels to identify cross-channel threats. We apply consistent security policies while still tailoring controls to the unique requirements of each channel. This approach prevents security gaps between channels while enabling you to manage security centrally with a complete view of your retail environment.

faqs.q: How quickly can SecuEdge be implemented in our retail environment?
faqs.a: Implementation timelines vary based on your environment complexity, but we typically complete initial deployment within 2-4 weeks, with full optimization over 1-3 months. However, we begin providing immediate protection from day one using our rapid deployment model. We prioritize protecting your payment systems and customer data first, then methodically expand protection across your entire retail environment while working around your peak business periods.
